THE WEDSPARKS GUIDE

Your 12-Month Wedding Planning Checklist

Use a year-long outline as a starting point, then adapt it to the size, style and time you have for your wedding.

Start your wedding planExplore suppliers

By WedSparks · Wedding planning guide

01

Around 12 months before

Agree your priorities, a comfortable budget and an approximate guest count. Explore venues and ceremony options, choose your date and begin enquiries with essential suppliers.

02

Around six to nine months before

Compare quotes and confirm suppliers. Think through outfits, travel and accommodation. Create your guest groups and decide how you will send invitations and collect replies.

03

Around three to five months before

Prepare invitations, menu choices and styling details. Confirm what your suppliers need from you and when. Start a wedding-day run sheet with venue access and ceremony time.

04

Around one to two months before

Follow up outstanding RSVPs, check dietary requirements, confirm key timings and review payments due. Share current plans with the suppliers who need them.

05

The final week

Confirm final numbers and contacts, pack essential items, share the current run sheet and hand over practical responsibilities. Make room for rest as well as last details.
